origin: Hatari c453b85f811fc11bed10e19e5e48fe95377e5a23 sound.c, as extracted in ym2149-mixer.json; single-channel logarithmic level data and fixed-level mapping, distinct from the separate Paulo Simoes measured 3-channel nonlinear table.
periods: Tone half-wave/envelope step is period*44100/250000 local frames; shared noise shift is period*44100/125000 frames. Period zero aliases one; masked zero registers are retained. Exact integer fractions of one local frame carry phase without a foreign clock/tick loop.
register_write_policy: Ordinary writes retain elapsed phase and generator bits/LFSR. R13 resets only shared envelope phase/position even for an unchanged shape. A reduced period behind carried phase resolves one overdue edge at the next local output sample; no sub-sample bus timeline is modeled. R14/R15 store masked bytes without machine GPIO effects.
mixing: Integrate gated single-channel amplitude sums over each local frame, scale to 32767/(3*65535), truncate; no reference 48kHz nonlinear mixer or PCM byte-identity target.
filters: Q16 low += (input*65536-low)*3/4; high = low-previous_low + high*32700/32768; previous_low = low; output high/65536 with signed truncation and int16 saturation. Applied once per 44100Hz output frame, histories carried across calls/writes/voice stop.
independent_expectations: Literal register masks, D/U/L/H envelope block table, fixed-to-5-bit mapping, eight hand-derived old-bit-output noise states, closed-form rational local sample positions and tone-frequency bounds. Thirty-two literal first-sample DC amplitude probes are independently calculated from pinned single-channel data and the documented host mix/filter policy; no expected waveform is generated by SyncTERM.
coverage: all masks and ignored register addresses
all 16 envelope shapes and looping endpoints
shared-noise trace and explicit zero seed
constant level with both gates disabled and DC rejection
voice-stop filter tail without phase reset
PCM/state invariance under varied partitions at fixed register-write sample positions
all original GIST patches composed at converted 200 updates/second local sample positions
unheard generator-state advance equivalent to rendering, with filter history discarded
GF(2) noise jumps including zero seed and complete sequence periods
bounded 64-bit unheard sample intervals invariant under subdivision
limitations: No auditory, physical device or reference-PCM waveform comparison.
IGS b/n/N parsing/session ownership, disabled-audio progression, console interaction and reset/disconnect/reconnect remain separate integration work.
